hd: [计] 层次相关性, 高密度
hdl: n a lipoprotein that transports cholesterol in the blood; composed of a high proportion of protein and relatively little cholesterol; high levels are thought to be associated with decreased risk of coronary heart disease and atherosclerosis
hdtv: abbr. 高清晰度电视（high-definition TV）
n a television system that has more than the usual number of lines per frame so its pictures show more detail
